Can Pulled Fangs be played after the opposing minion has played a press, or
must it be played before (ie. directly after strike resolution)?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris wrote:
> Can Pulled Fangs be played after the opposing minion has played a press, or
> must it be played before (ie. directly after strike resolution)?

It cannot be played before presses.

Pulled Fangs - Combat

* Is used when a round ends - after presses, or
whenever the round ends (if it is ended
prematurely). [RTR 961113]
